name: smol machines Sandbox
description: Run each sandbox as a smol machine: a real Linux microVM on this host with the workspace mounted like the Docker backend, no container runtime required.

command.label: smol Command
command.help: Path or command name for the smol CLI (the smolvm CLI is accepted too).

image.label: Image
image.help: OCI image each machine boots. It needs /bin/sh, GNU coreutils and python3; the default is python:3.12-slim.

memoryMb.label: Memory (MiB)
memoryMb.help: RAM ceiling per machine. The host commits only what the guest uses.

workdir.label: Workdir
workdir.help: Absolute path inside the machine where the sandbox workspace is mounted. Overrides sandbox.docker.workdir.

branchable.label: Branchable
branchable.help: Start machines so they can be branched with `smol machine branch` (copy-on-write RAM). Costs nothing until a branch is taken.

timeoutSeconds.label: Command Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for smol CLI lifecycle operations such as create, start and delete.
